verdict.rationale: Gusto's docs state that companies with multiple work locations can choose to pay everyone at the same time or use different pay schedules, and separately document multi-location management as a platform feature, supporting the ability to run different schedules across teams/locations. However, the evidence never explicitly enumerates schedule frequency options (weekly/biweekly/semimonthly/monthly) or shows the actual configuration workflow for assigning distinct schedules per team, and this is framed as an Embedded Payroll API capability for partners rather than a direct ops-user UI feature. Missing for 10: explicit list of supported pay frequencies, UI/API walkthrough for assigning different schedules to different teams, and independent/hands-on confirmation.
